translations.b0072: Part 3  Accelerating High-Level Self-Reliance in Science and Technology and Fostering New Quality Productive Forces
translations.b0073: China will seize the historic opportunities presented by a new round of scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation, take coordinated steps to build itself into a leading country in education, science and technology, and human resources, improve the overall performance of the national innovation system, comprehensively strengthen its capacity for independent innovation, seize the commanding heights of scientific and technological development, promote the deep integration of scientific and technological innovation with industrial innovation, and continuously foster new quality productive forces.
translations.b0074: Chapter 8  Strengthening Original Innovation and Efforts to Make Breakthroughs in Core Technologies in Key Fields
translations.b0075: China will combine technology-driven and demand-pulled approaches, combine forging strengths and remedying weaknesses, improve the new system for mobilizing resources nationwide, and produce more landmark original achievements.
translations.b0076: Section 1  Winning the Battle for Breakthroughs in Core Technologies in Key Fields
translations.b0077: Focusing on strategically vital fields and weak links in industrial and supply chains, China will take extraordinary measures and drive whole-chain efforts to achieve decisive breakthroughs in core technologies in key fields such as integrated circuits, industrial machine tools, high-end instruments, basic software, advanced materials and biomanufacturing. It will improve the demand-oriented mechanism for identifying research tasks and carry out technological and economic security assessments. It will strengthen cross-field and interdisciplinary coordination, improve the mechanism for the special allocation of talent for major tasks, refine systems such as “enlisting the best candidates to lead research” and “horse racing,” and explore funding support methods such as replacing subsidies with awards and retrospective subsidies. It will strengthen the approach of letting application drive research and integrating research with application, take an integrated approach to technological research and development, the commercialization of achievements, standards development and industrial cultivation, and accelerate the application of research results and the iterative upgrading of products.
translations.b0078: Section 2  Strengthening Science and Technology Layout in Strategic Frontier Fields
translations.b0079: Aiming at the global frontiers of science and technology, China will strengthen systematic planning, implement strategic science and technology deployments in artificial intelligence, quantum technology, biotechnology, new energy and other fields, accelerate breakthroughs in basic theories and underlying technologies, and promote their commercialization and application. It will organize cutting-edge technology forecasting and foresight at a high level, establish a national list of critical and emerging technologies, and continue to advance research and development in frontier technologies. It will strengthen the orientation toward original innovation in scientific research and technological development, optimize the environment conducive to original and disruptive innovation, innovate the selection and funding mechanisms for non-consensus projects, and expand the scale and proportion of original and disruptive projects in major national science and technology tasks and in the National Natural Science Foundation of China. It will highlight national strategic needs, make solid progress in major national science and technology projects, and deploy major national science and technology programs oriented toward 2035 in advance.
translations.b0080: Section 3  Comprehensively Raising the Level of Basic Research
translations.b0081: China will strengthen the strategic, forward-looking and systematic layout of basic research and take coordinated steps to advance both goal-oriented and free-exploration basic research. It will accelerate the formation of a diversified funding structure for basic research, increase fiscal investment, improve tax incentive policies, guide localities, enterprises, social organizations and individuals with the capacity to do so to support basic research, encourage the establishment of public welfare funds for basic research, and achieve a marked increase in the share of basic research spending in R&D spending. It will improve the funding mechanism that combines competitive support with stable support, increase long-term and stable support for strong teams and young scientific and technological talent engaged in basic research, and explore long-cycle funding models. It will encourage high-risk, high-value basic research and foster a sound environment that encourages exploration and tolerates failure. Focusing on scientific frontiers at the extremely macro and extremely micro scales, under extreme conditions, and in highly integrated interdisciplinary fields, it will strengthen basic research in emerging fields, interdisciplinary integration and cross-disciplinary areas.
translations.b0083: China will take coordinated steps to build national strategic scientific and technological forces, improve the efficiency of innovation resource allocation, and build an independent, complete, open and efficient national innovation system.
translations.b0084: Section 1  Enhancing the Leading Role of National Strategic Scientific and Technological Forces
translations.b0085: China will optimize the positioning and layout of national strategic scientific and technological forces such as national laboratories, national research institutions, high-level research universities and leading science and technology enterprises. It will give play to the leading role of national laboratories, support them in taking the lead in implementing major national science and technology tasks and exploring new models of research organization, and strengthen the building of national key laboratories. It will accelerate the adjustment, optimization and reorganization of the layout of national research institutions and improve management and operational mechanisms suited to their functions and positioning. It will support high-level research universities in creating a first-class academic environment and in becoming the main force in basic research and the main front for talent cultivation. It will cultivate and strengthen leading science and technology enterprises and enhance their capacity to integrate innovation resources and build industrial ecosystems. It will encourage and regulate the development of new types of research and development institutions.
translations.b0086: Section 2  Strengthening Support for Scientific and Technological Innovation Resources
translations.b0087: China will strengthen the coordinated mechanism for deploying science and technology tasks and improve the national decision-making consultation system for major science and technology matters. It will improve the mechanism for the allocation, management and use of central government science and technology funds, improve the mechanism for central and local governments to share investment in major science and technology tasks, and improve investment performance. It will expand the scope of the “lump-sum funding” system for fiscal science and technology research projects and give scientists greater decision-making power over technical routes, greater control over funds and greater authority to deploy resources. It will strengthen the independent provision of basic conditions for science and technology, coordinate the building of science and technology innovation platforms and bases, systematically plan and build major science and technology infrastructure, strengthen the development of supporting conditions such as high-end scientific research instruments, scientific journals and scientific data, and enhance the opening and sharing of resources. It will improve the regional innovation system, strengthen the source function of international science and technology innovation centers, plan and build regional science and technology innovation centers and industrial science and technology innovation highlands, enhance the clustering effect of innovation resources in comprehensive national science centers, and improve the innovation mechanism featuring central-local coordination and regional synergy.
translations.b0088: Section 3  Creating a New Pattern of High-Level Opening Up and Cooperation in Science and Technology
translations.b0089: China will foster an open innovation ecosystem with global competitiveness and support joint efforts with researchers from other countries to tackle basic frontier scientific problems. It will give play to the role of science research funds open to the world, expand the opening up of science and technology programs, establish and improve management systems for the cross-border allocation and overseas use of science and technology funds and mechanisms for the safe and orderly cross-border flow of research data, and promote the opening of major research infrastructure and platforms to scientists around the world. It will improve the management mechanisms for foreign professional exchanges and cooperation by universities, research institutes and science and technology societies. It will take the lead in implementing and actively participate in international big science programs and big science projects, support the establishment of international science and technology organizations in China, and create international science and technology awards with global influence.
translations.b0090: Chapter 10  Strengthening the Principal Role of Enterprises in Scientific and Technological Innovation
translations.b0091: China will ensure that enterprises play the principal role in technological innovation decision-making, research and development investment, research organization, and the commercialization and application of achievements, and promote the deep integration of the innovation chain, the industrial chain, the capital chain and the talent chain.
translations.b0092: Section 1  Channeling Innovation Resources Toward Enterprises
translations.b0093: China will establish and improve a policy system for channeling innovation resources such as projects, platforms, data and talent toward enterprises. It will increase enterprises’ participation in major national science and technology innovation decisions, make key generic technology needs in industry an important direction of support under national science and technology programs, and incorporate major science and technology projects of qualified enterprises into the national science and technology program system. It will support enterprises in undertaking more national science and technology research tasks and give lead enterprises greater autonomy in setting technical routes, advancing research tasks, selecting participating entities and allocating and using funds. It will give priority to supporting key science and technology enterprises in building national science and technology innovation platforms and bases, and increase the opening of national scientific data, engineering test data and talent programs to enterprises. It will improve policies on researchers starting businesses after leaving their posts and on taking part-time jobs with additional pay, and encourage outstanding talent to flow to enterprises.
translations.b0094: Section 2  Strengthening Enterprise-Led Integrated Innovation Among Industry, Academia and Research
translations.b0095: China will encourage enterprises to carry out joint research in response to industrial needs together with universities and research institutes. It will support key science and technology enterprises in taking the lead in forming innovation consortia and in conducting research and development on key generic technologies and pilot testing and demonstration applications of scientific and technological achievements. It will deepen reform to grant greater rights over job-related scientific and technological achievements, establish a system for the separate listing and management of job-related scientific and technological achievements as assets, advance the building of a technology transfer system, and accelerate the efficient commercialization and application of scientific and technological achievements. It will guide universities and research institutes in licensing scientific and technological innovation achievements to small and medium-sized enterprises on a “use first, pay later” basis. It will encourage leading science and technology enterprises to open research conditions and application scenarios to small, medium and micro enterprises and provide technology development services.
translations.b0096: Section 3  Improving the Policy System for Promoting Enterprise Innovation
translations.b0097: China will strengthen the supply of inclusive policies and create a sound environment conducive to enterprise innovation. It will support the development of high-tech enterprises and small and medium-sized science and technology enterprises and raise the proportion of additional tax deductions for enterprise research and development expenses. It will establish an enterprise research and development reserve fund system. It will build a science and technology finance system compatible with scientific and technological innovation, improve policies for supporting long-term capital in making early-stage, small-scale, long-term and hard-tech investments, support high-quality science and technology enterprises in going public for financing and issuing bonds, build the “sci-tech board” of the bond market to a high standard, vigorously develop venture capital, broaden the sources of medium- and long-term venture capital funds through multiple channels, and give play to the role of national venture capital guidance funds and national-level merger and acquisition funds. It will make it easier for foreign capital to conduct equity investment and venture capital in China. It will increase government procurement of independently innovated products. It will establish a science and technology insurance policy system and enrich science and technology insurance products. It will strengthen whole-chain intellectual property protection, optimize patent and trademark examination policies, and fully implement the patent open licensing system.
translations.b0098: Chapter 11  Taking Integrated Steps to Develop Education, Science and Technology, and Human Resources
translations.b0099: China will deepen integrated reform of education, science and technology, and human resources, strengthen the alignment of plans, coordination of policies, pooling of resources and linkage of evaluations, and promote positive interaction between independent scientific and technological innovation and independent talent cultivation.
translations.b0100: Section 1  Establishing and Improving a Coordinated Mechanism for Integrated Advancement
translations.b0101: China will improve the mechanism for the coordinated implementation of education, science and technology, and human resources strategies and strengthen the organic alignment of strategic goals, the integrated deployment of strategic tasks, the coordinated efforts of policies and measures, and the coordinated allocation of resources and factors. It will promote the coordinated layout of platforms and bases for education, science and technology, and human resources, and build education centers, science centers and talent centers with global influence. It will explore the establishment of coordinated management mechanisms for education, science and technology, and human resources in localities where conditions permit. It will accelerate the building of national strategic talent forces in response to innovation needs and increase efforts to cultivate and support strategic scientists, leading science and technology talent, basic research talent and young science and technology talent. It will strengthen talent collaboration, optimize the talent structure, improve orderly mobility mechanisms, and promote coordinated regional development of talent.
translations.b0102: Section 2  Taking Coordinated Steps to Cultivate Innovative Talent
translations.b0103: China will take coordinated steps to cultivate talent in response to scientific and technological innovation, industrial development and national strategic needs, and improve the quality of independent talent cultivation. Focusing on advantageous disciplines and urgent strategic needs, it will appropriately expand the scope of the “Double First-Class” initiative and establish a number of new research universities. It will improve the mechanism for adjusting the disciplines and majors offered in higher education, make extraordinary arrangements for the layout of disciplines and majors urgently needed in emerging fields such as artificial intelligence and integrated circuits, and deepen implementation of the breakthrough plan for basic and interdisciplinary disciplines. It will strengthen the talent aggregation and cultivation functions of research institutions, innovation platforms, enterprises and science and technology programs, and tilt enrollment quotas toward entities undertaking major science and technology tasks. It will explore new models for cultivating top-notch innovative talent, strengthen the cultivation of young people’s scientific literacy, critical thinking and innovation capacity, strengthen coordination between science and technology education and humanities education, and strengthen the integrated cultivation of undergraduate, master’s and doctoral students in basic disciplines, interdisciplinary fields and strategically urgent areas.
translations.b0104: Section 3  Taking Coordinated Steps to Innovate Incentive and Evaluation Mechanisms
translations.b0105: With innovation capacity, quality, effectiveness and contribution as the evaluation orientation, China will deepen reform of project review, institutional evaluation, talent evaluation and income distribution to stimulate the impetus and vitality for innovation and creation. It will carry out basic research evaluation focused primarily on the originality and academic value of results and improve international peer review. It will implement applied research and technological development evaluation based primarily on user and market feedback, and make new technologies and new products an important basis for performance assessment, professional title appraisal and support under talent programs. It will give employers greater autonomy in talent evaluation and prevent the simple use of titles and honors to determine remuneration and allocate resources. It will improve supporting policies on staffing, remuneration, professional title appointment, assessment and promotion, and smooth the channels for talent exchange among universities, research institutes and enterprises. It will improve support and guarantee mechanisms for talent introduced from overseas, establish a high-tech talent immigration system, and attract and cultivate outstanding talent from around the world. It will strengthen the popularization of science and technology, cultivate an innovation culture and promote the spirit of scientists. It will strengthen the development of the rule of law, ethics, integrity and security in science and technology.
